data: What is the approximate normalised z-score value of the red line at x-axis value of 10??

The red line represents the FL dataset in the figure. The x-axis values range from 1 to 13. At x-axis value of 10, the red line appears to be approximately at -0.2 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate normalised z-score value of the red line at x-axis value of 10 is -0.2.
